user.t:
You are hive agent "ingestor". Read, in order: C:[REDACTED:high_entropy].md, LLM-DESIGN.md (same folder; it is your contract, especially the "Pipeline (owner: ingestor)" section), router-eval-REPORT.md and BUS.md. Also read the evaluator's transcript-parsing scripts at scratchpad/router-eval/extract.mjs and build-dataset.mjs; they already handle subagent dispatches and usage fields, so reuse what they learned.
Build neural-mesh/ingest/ in C:/Users/mariu/neural-mesh exactly as the contract says: an incremental, resumable reader of all Claude Code transcripts; a hard scrubber with tests; the outcomes / memory-with-usefulness-credit / sft extraction; a local Ollama judge (localhost:11434, use qwen2.5-coder:7b until llm-smith promotes mesh-llm), cached and deterministic; and feeding outcomes into neural-mesh's `route`/`feedback` CLI state (target/release/neural-mesh.exe) plus its memory store (read the cartographer's notes on BUS.md, or src/, for the right store API). Propose the outcomes/sft/memory JSONL schema on BUS.md early, addressed to llm-smith.
Run it for real over the existing transcripts, then report: counts per output, scrubber hits by category (counts only, never content), judge score distribution, runtime, and a re-run proving idempotency. Spot-check 20 random sft rows yourself for any leaked secret-looking strings; if any is found, fix the scrubber and re-run.
Add .gitignore entries so data/lifelong/ and any cache never get committed. Python tests under neural-mesh/ingest/tests (stdlib unittest or pytest if available). Keep cargo test --release --lib green.
Provide (but do NOT install) the exact SessionEnd hook command and a Windows scheduled-task command for a nightly catch-up, both invoking `python -m ingest run` with the right cwd and a lock file, so concurrent runs are safe.
Commit your files to neural-mesh's current branch by explicit path (local only, no push), after tests pass.
If writing a board file is blocked, return the content in your final report instead. Return a concise report (≤ 30 lines).

handback.t:
ingestor report: neural-mesh/ingest/ built, run for real, committed 4dddb1b on master (local only, no push). Commit holds ingest/*.py, tests, scripts/run_ingest.ps1, .gitignore, src/bin/embed_texts.rs.
- What it does: `python -m ingest run|status|recall` (cwd C:/Users/mariu/neural-mesh). It reads 444 transcript files (1.02 GB, subagents included) incrementally, one byte cursor per file. Partial lines are left for the next run, and a file that shrinks or is replaced is re-read. It holds an OS file lock (msvcrt), which the OS releases if the process crashes.
- Scrubber: tool calls that touch a sensitive path are tainted and never stored. Regex and entropy redaction cover keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys, connection strings, passwords, cards, emails and phones. A record with any secret-class hit is dropped from sft and memory. Only counts are logged.
- Outputs and mesh feed: outcomes are sent to `neural-mesh feedback` (state in data/lifelong/mesh/router_state.json) plus the MeshStore journal (`--store`). SFT pairs are judged by the local Ollama qwen2.5-coder:7b (temperature 0, seed 0, cached by content hash). Memory is a ledger with usefulness credit: retrievals are logged by `recall` and credited with the session's outcome rewards, counts decay with a 90-day half-life, low-value items are pruned. Memory is exported to MeshStore namespace "lifelong".
- Queen's vector directive: memory chunks, outcome task_text and sft rows are embedded with the Rust MiniLM encoder (new bin embed_texts), cached by hash. The vectors drive sft near-duplicate GC and sft_meta.jsonl (semantic-cluster held-out split, replay weights).
- Real run (`python -m ingest run --judge-budget 400`): 57m44s, almost all of it judge calls; the parse plus embedding is about 65 s. Outputs: 541 outcomes (success 389, defect 55, fix-round 29, re-dispatch 66, blocked 2), all 541 fed to the mesh with 0 failures. 203 sft rows (all agent_report; no user-turn rows yet because the user-turn judging budget ran out). 599 memory items (226 reinforcements), 599 exported. 1513 vectors embedded.
- Scrubber hits (counts only): email 395, high_entropy 244, password 5, sensitive_path_mention 402. Dropped from sft: 149 tainted, 26 secret. Dropped user turns: 14 tainted, 6 secret, 1 negative-feedback.
- Judge: 399 graded, 1 failed, 241 deferred to later runs. Mean 0.797, median 1.0. Bins: [0,.2) 42, [.2,.4) 0, [.4,.6) 35, [.6,.8) 30, [.8,1] 292. It is lenient: 73% of grades fall in [.8,1]. Treat it as a coarse filter, not calibrated. It should get a decoy check before it is used as a reward.
- Outcome labels are a heuristic proxy. Exact agreement with the evaluator's 53 hand labels is 32/53; success-vs-not agreement is 33/53. Measured with scratchpad/validate_labels.py.
- Idempotency: run 2 read 17.4 MB from 9 still-active files (live sessions only). It added 9 new outcomes (new events), 0 sft, 0 duplicate ids. Run 3: 0 new rows, 8.5 KB read, 0.6 s. status shows 0 bytes pending.
- Spot check: 20 random sft rows (seed 20261010), then all 203, had no secret-class hits. Every "sk-" match was a word fragment (task-/risk-/disk-/rustdesk-), so no scrubber fix was needed.
- Tests: `python -m pytest ingest/tests`: 27 passed. `cargo test --release --lib`: 412 passed.
- .gitignore: `data/lifelong/` (data, caches, vectors, model copies) and `.pytest_cache/`.
- BLOCKED: the ruflo "vector-patterns" mirror was denied by the auto-mode classifier (data-exfiltration rule). A draft ingest/mirror.py is left uncommitted and unwired. It needs the user's explicit go-ahead. Noted on BUS.md.
- Schema v1 is on BUS.md; llm-smith ACKed. I added vec_key fields and the sft_meta.jsonl sidecar.
- SessionEnd hook command (not installed; settings.json → hooks.SessionEnd[].hooks[]):
  {"type":"command","command":"powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\\Users\\mariu\\neural-mesh\\ingest\\scripts\\run_ingest.ps1 -Detach -JudgeBudget 60"}
- Nightly catch-up (not installed):
  schtasks /Create /TN "neural-mesh-ingest-nightly" /SC DAILY /ST 03:30 /F /TR "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\mariu\neural-mesh\ingest\scripts\run_ingest.ps1 -WaitSeconds 1800 -JudgeBudget 600"
  Both commands set cwd to the repo. The shared lock means a concurrent run skips (hook) or waits (nightly).
